svg.title: Project map, contribution city and languages
svg.desc: Project map of 10 published projects: UsageOS (DEVTOOLS, OS series, JavaScript, 1 star), ResearchOS (AI, OS series, Python, 1 star), ClipOS (MEDIA, OS series, Python), CompanionOS (SYSTEMS, OS series, TypeScript), NetOS (SYSTEMS, OS series, Python, 1 star), FREYA (AI, OS series, Python, 1 star), Cosmic Explorer (WEB, JavaScript), Finwise (FINTECH, JavaScript), N8N-YT (AUTOMATION, 1 star), RepoHealth (WEB, TypeScript, 1 star). Connections from shared repository metadata: shared language JavaScript: Cosmic Explorer, Finwise, UsageOS; shared language Python: ClipOS, FREYA, NetOS, ResearchOS; shared language TypeScript: ClipOS, CompanionOS, RepoHealth. Node size reflects stars on a bounded scale. Contribution city: isometric view of 1,148 contributions from 2025-11-14 to 2026-11-14 across 104 active days. Each tile is one day; taller tiles mean more contributions relative to the busiest day (54). GitHub contribution calendar: all activity, including repositories not featured here. One tile per day, height = relative daily contributions. Languages by bytes of code in public repositories, bubble area proportional to share: Python 50.6%, TypeScript 27.9%, JavaScript 13.0%, CSS 5.3%, Other 3.1%.
